text:
Maya (recruiter): Hey team, 3 candidates flagged that their take-home interview invites showed up 24h off. Anyone seen this with the new ATS -> calendar mapping?
Ethan (talent-ops): Ugh yes, saw 2 yesterday but thought it was DST weirdness. Which calendar provider?
Maya (recruiter): Google Calendar. ATS event created as UTC but invite shows in candidate timezone incorrectly (e.g., 11am -> 11pm).
Priya (people-ops): That matches a mapping change we rolled last week to normalize timestamps. @Jae any idea if the webhook payload changed?
Jae (eng): Checking logs now. scheduler-bot reported successful conversion but payload had tz=null for a handful of events. Could be the middleware falling back to account.profile.tz which some candidates don't have.
scheduler-bot: [automated] 2371112235: POST /webhooks/sched created_event id=evt_9c3 tz=null status=200
Ethan (talent-ops): Candidates without profile tz is common for external hires. Should be defaulting to recruiter locale or event requester locale.
Maya (recruiter): Two hires missed the live session :( we switched to manual invites mid-day. Want a temp fix + long-term fix.
Priya (people-ops): Temp fix: can we change ATS -> calendar mapping to default to the *requester* timezone if tz missing? That would match current recruiter behavior.
Jae (eng): Quick patch possible: change fallback order to requester.tz -> account.tz -> UTC. I can push a hotfix to staging in 30m, need approval to prod deploy.
Ethan (talent-ops): Approve deploy for prod hotfix. Also can we add a one-off backfill script to reschedule any events created in last 48h with tz=null?
Jae (eng): Yep. I'll run a dry-run to list affected events first:
```
SELECT id, candidate_email, created_at FROM events WHERE payload->> 'tz' IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '48 hours';
```
Maya (recruiter): Please include candidate emails so we can reach out before changing invites.
Priya (people-ops): I'll draft a quick email template for impacted candidates and interviewers. Maya, can you confirm who should own outreach?
Maya (recruiter): I will own outreach for external candidates; internal interviewers please ping calendar attendees after we reschedule.
Jae (eng): Dry-run shows 7 events. I'll coordinate the prod deploy + backfill at 3pm PST to minimize disruption.
scheduler-bot: [automated] deploy queued by Jae at 2371112260
Ethan (talent-ops): Thanks. After backfill, can we add an alert when payload.tz is missing so ops knows before invites go out?
Priya (people-ops): Yes — add an alert and a postmortem checklist item: confirm tz fallback ordering when we change mapping.
Maya (recruiter): One more note — update the ATS interviewer guide to mention checking requester timezone on bulk invites. Saved us a lot today. :+1:
Jae (eng): Will post deployment note in #eng-oncall once done and attach the query results.
Maya (recruiter): Great, thanks everyone.
Priya (people-ops): Closing loop: hotfix approved, backfill scheduled, candidate outreach owner assigned. I'll update the incident doc after deploy.
